dedupe_keys.name: pangandaran coastal uav lidar and terrain derivatives

description: The current public Zenodo version provides UAV LiDAR point clouds, terrain and surface models, ground-control material, and processing reports for coastal tourism areas of Pangandaran, West Java. The article reports a mean point density near 865 points per square metre and independent check-point root-mean-square errors of about 0.07 metres east, 0.06 metres north and 0.14 metres vertically. The release lists twenty-eight files or RAR archives under CC BY 4.0. The article-cited DOI 10.5281/zenodo.17073404 and current version DOI 10.5281/zenodo.17712896 share one Zenodo concept record. Coverage is a mapped coastal strip, not a tsunami inundation model, building-vulnerability survey or complete regional elevation base. Vegetation classification, survey footprint and single acquisition period limit hazard interpretations. A reviewer-assessed simulation use is setting local terrain and exposed built-form states for tsunami scenarios. data-ign-lidar-hd-point-clouds is a related LiDAR source from another setting. No point cloud, archive or terrain raster was downloaded or checked.
